# M7-S3 cross-package comptime generic whose field type comes from a
# package the instantiating source never names (SPEC Sec 2.5, T-205;
# T-0.3, T-Sec6). Package wire holds Row, whose Level field has the type
# deep.Level, and an exported comptime generic Describe that converts each
# field with Convert[f.Type](in)? and interpolates a string built from the
# result. Package main instantiates Describe[wire.Row] and imports neither
# deep nor anything that spells it, so the expansion copy in main spells
# deep.Level through a synthesized import alias. The copy must type-check
# under that alias for the `?` and the interpolation to lower. The ejected
# tree holds the copy as plain Go with the synthesized import, runs under
# plain go with the output logos run prints, and stays vet- and gofmt-clean.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

cp ../want.txt $WORK/want.txt

# logos runs the module before eject and prints the complete output.
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it (#112).
mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo
cp deep/deep.lgo $WORK/orig/deep.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/wire/wire.go
exists out/deep/deep.go

# No ejected file imports comptime, and no expansion marker leaks.
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/wire/wire.go
! grep '_logos_ctpkg' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_tparam' out/main.go

# The copy in main reaches deep through a synthesized import alias.
grep '_logos_t[0-9]+ "example.com/ejectforeign/deep"' out/main.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with the same complete output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

# The source tree is unchanged after eject (#112).
cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo
cmp deep/deep.lgo $WORK/orig/deep.lgo

-- want.txt --
Name=7;Level=L7;Count=7; <nil>
bad: expected integer
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectforeign

go 1.27

-- m/deep/deep.lgo --
package deep

import "strconv"

type Level int

func (l Level) String() string {
	return "L" + strconv.Itoa(int(l))
}

-- m/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectforeign/deep"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Level deep.Level
	Count int
}

func Convert[V any](s string) (V, error) {
	var v V
	_, err := fmt.Sscan(s, &v)
	return v, err
}

func Show[V any](v V) string {
	return fmt.Sprint(v)
}

func Describe[T any](in string) (string, error) {
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		v := Convert[f.Type](in)?
		out += $"{f.Name}={Show(v)};"
	}
	return out, nil
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectforeign/wire"
)

func main() {
	out, err := wire.Describe[wire.Row]("7")
	fmt.Println(out, err)
	_, err = wire.Describe[wire.Row]("x")
	fmt.Println("bad:", err)
}
